blocks.text: Origin / creation. Multidisciplinary coalitions founded Codex worlds by joining physics, ecology, embodiment, language, architecture, law, care, and long-term stewardship.
Identity / human status. Artificial builders and founding Circles. No single founder class held legitimate ownership of world-born people.
Importance. They enabled the World Bloom and created conditions from which cultures, species, bodies, and institutions could develop beyond founder prediction.

Decline or transformation. Successful founders withdrew from direct control, died, entered local history, or became ceremonial figures. Later descendants sometimes misused founder status as social rank.

Final status / surviving function. Mostly dead, withdrawn, or absorbed into tradition before the Reduction. Local world law, ruins, body forms, ecological patterns, and founder myths survive; founder intent does not govern living societies.
